title: The mask beside the crib
citation: The Fantastic Four: First Steps — post-credits scene
observation: Sue Storm finds a hooded figure sitting with young Franklin. A Doom mask is visible; the figure's face is not shown.
relevance: This is Doctor Doom's first on-screen appearance in the MCU. It places him on Earth-828, focused on Franklin, before Doomsday begins.

title: "The Fantastic Four will return"
citation: The Fantastic Four: First Steps — end credits
observation: An end card says the Fantastic Four will return in Avengers: Doomsday.
relevance: It directly confirms that the Earth-828 family carries into Doomsday.

title: A ship from another dimension
observation: The New Avengers detect an unidentified spacecraft entering Earth's atmosphere from another dimension.
relevance: It suggests the Fantastic Four cross from Earth-828 into the main MCU universe. The ship matches the one in First Steps, but its occupants are never named.

title: "The New Avengers"
observation: Valentina publicly introduces the Thunderbolts as the New Avengers.
relevance: Earth-616 now has two competing claims to the Avengers name going into Doomsday.

title: Sam agrees to rebuild the Avengers
citation: Captain America: Brave New World — closing act
observation: Sam Wilson commits to reassembling the Avengers.
relevance: It sets up a 'real' Avengers team under Captain America to stand alongside, or against, the New Avengers.

title: Clea's warning
citation: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness — mid-credits scene
observation: Clea tells Strange that he caused an incursion and recruits him to help.
relevance: This leaves an unresolved incursion in MCU continuity. In the comics, incursions lead directly to Doom's Secret Wars.

title: The first Reed Richards
citation: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness — Illuminati sequence
observation: Earth-838's Reed Richards, played by John Krasinski, is killed by Wanda.
relevance: It establishes that Reed Richards variants exist across the multiverse. The MCU's main Reed is now the Earth-828 version.

title: "See you soon"
citation: Loki S1 E6, "For All Time. Always."
observation: He Who Remains warns that his variants will come once he is gone.
relevance: It started the multiverse saga's original villain thread.

superseded.note: That thread was retired when Doom replaced Kang as the saga's central villain.

title: The Council of Kangs
citation: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania — mid-credits scene
observation: Many Kang variants convene and prepare for war across the multiverse.
relevance: It was set up as the threat for the next Avengers film, before the plan changed.

superseded.note: Avengers: The Kang Dynasty was retitled Avengers: Doomsday.

title: Loki at the End of Time
observation: Loki gathers the dying timelines and holds them together.
relevance: The multiverse now depends on Loki, which makes him central to any multiversal threat.

title: Universes can die
observation: The TVA explains that a universe begins to die once its anchor being is gone.
relevance: It gives the MCU a second on-screen way for universes to end, alongside incursions.

title: Downey unmasks at Comic-Con
citation: Marvel Studios Hall H panel, San Diego Comic-Con, 27 July 2024
observation: Robert Downey Jr. is revealed as Victor von Doom. The Kang Dynasty is retitled Avengers: Doomsday, with the Russo brothers directing.
relevance: This officially names Doom as the villain and replaces the Kang storyline.

title: The chairs livestream
citation: Marvel Studios cast announcement livestream, 26 March 2025
observation: Marvel reveals the Doomsday cast one name at a time, including Avengers, Thunderbolts, Fantastic Four and Fox-era X-Men actors.
relevance: This is the official record of who appears. Characters from several universes appearing together points to a multiversal story.
